inputs: No client materials; original self-originated portfolio concepts

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a finished standalone original fantasy illustration intended as a sample for an adult 500–1000 piece jigsaw puzzle, landscape 3:2 composition, highest practical native detail/resolution. Primary request: create an intricate coherent fantasy world filling the entire image with differentiated details and many satisfying local landmarks, with absolutely no large empty sky, blank ground or flat expanses. Scene: an immense ancient living tree transformed into a vertical inhabited city, built around a luminous amber inner heart. A wide view from an elevated stone footbridge reveals dozens of handcrafted stone-and-timber homes, spiral staircases winding around roots and branches, wooden suspension bridges, glass greenhouses, a miniature outdoor book market, a copper-roof clockmaker workshop, mushroom gardens, a narrow aqueduct carrying water through the lower town, small lanterns and restrained tiny travelers doing distinct activities. Foreground: textured carved bridge rail, moss, herbs, pottery and an old mapmaking table, providing crisp recognizable puzzle areas at all four corners. Middle ground: warm glowing tree-city architecture with visible structural logic; background is densely woven overlapping leaves, distant treehouses and cliffside terraces rather than empty sky. Clear readable scale hierarchy, distinct silhouettes, consistent perspective, no repeated cloned buildings. Style: richly observed painterly fantasy/worldbuilding for adults, sophisticated naturalistic illustrative rendering, fine handcraft textures, precise yet imaginative architectural detail, not children's cartoon, not photorealistic collage. Lighting: late-afternoon gold through green canopy, cool teal shadows, small warm lantern accents. Palette: varied moss green, teal, terracotta, ochre, warm ivory and aged copper; distributed contrasting micro-regions throughout so puzzle assembly is enjoyable. Constraints: one continuous full-bleed illustration, no borders, no puzzle-piece outlines, no typography, no logo, no watermark, no split panels, no product mockup. Crisp details but coherent visual storytelling; avoid indecipherable decorative noise, large dark muddy areas and heavily blurred backgrounds. This is wholly self-originated public portfolio art, not a commission or client-supplied artwork.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a finished standalone original fantasy illustration intended as a second own portfolio concept for an adult 500–1000 piece jigsaw puzzle. Landscape 3:2, highest available native resolution and rich legible detail. Primary request: a fantastical aerial harbor built among tall floating basalt islands, filled from edge to edge with clearly differentiated objects and activities. Make a visually distinct second world from warm forest/treehouse fantasy: cool ultramarine and turquoise sea far below, pale limestone and blue tiled port architecture, vermilion awnings, brass navigation instruments, white sails, lapis mosaics, violet flowers, striped ropes. There is almost no open sky: dense airships, rigging, hanging gardens, a rocky arch, terraces, towers and bridges fill the upper half; the sea seen through gaps is broken into rippling reflection patterns and many small boats rather than blank water. Main scene: an elegant weathered blue-and-brass sailing airship moored at a bustling cliffside skyport. Foreground across the entire lower border: a cartographer's stone terrace with colorful charts without readable writing, an astrolabe, carefully arranged ropes, ceramic cargo jars, potted herbs, striped textiles and a few tiny dock workers. Midground: a stepped marketplace and customs house, carved bridges, cranes lifting crates, lighthouse-like towers, mechanically coherent masts and gangways. Background: additional inhabited floating islands at varied depths, connected by fine bridges and crossing vessels, clear atmospheric layers but still detailed. Sophisticated adult narrative fantasy/worldbuilding illustration, finely crafted painterly realism, crisp local silhouettes, consistent perspective and structural logic, restrained golden sunset highlights against cool shadows, no muddy large shadows. Every corner offers distinct landmarks and color families suitable for puzzle assembly. One continuous full-bleed coherent image only: no borders, split panels, jigsaw cut lines, typography, logos, watermarks or product mockups. Avoid giant empty cloud or sky regions, repetitive cloned forms, blurry atmospheric blankness, decorative visual noise and cartoon style. Entirely self-originated public sample art with no private client materials.
